title: Ok but obvious cracks from heat fracturing.
text: Ok but obvious cracks from heat fracturing.. they are nice, there are just fractures under the glaze due to poor firing. According to google " In glazed ware the glaze causes stress due to the thermal expansion. The interaction of the glaze and the clay body causes stress on the pot in glaze firing." Its okay.. It wasn't worth returning them. But I'd be cautious about purchasing ceramics from them.
